acceptance_criteria: Define versioned dataset manifest and evaluation report contracts for Flange QC v2 MLOps handoff.

Add Python validators that accept sanitized metadata-only manifests and reject raw media paths, unsafe path references, unknown schema versions, missing label/split/metric metadata, PII/customer-data flags, production authority, and unapproved promotion.
Dataset contract captures snapshot ID, label set, entity grain, split policy, split counts, source reference, privacy class, and storage reference without storing raw files.
Evaluation contract captures model reference, dataset snapshot reference, key metrics, slice metrics, latency budget evidence, approval status, source reference, and no production authority.
Docs explain how the owner/MLOps provider should hand off dataset and eval artifacts to the app without committing raw datasets, secrets, model weights, or notebooks.
Required local checks pass and no restricted behavior is introduced.

memory_preflight.query: flange_qc_v2 dataset MLOps handoff contract evaluation report manifest
retrieved_decisions: MLOps owns dataset management, model training/eval, promotion criteria, raw dataset retention, and privacy controls.
The app accepts model integration through safe contracts only and cannot grant detector PASS/NG authority.
retrieved_lessons: Prepare integration boundaries before model/dataset artifacts arrive.
Do not allow raw datasets, weights, secrets, or production authority in app-code PRs.
restricted_areas: model weights/model deserialization/training code/TensorRT engines/ONNX/PyTorch execution

rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-022 PR to remove dataset/eval handoff schemas, validators, tests, docs, and gate evidence. No production data migration, release rollback, model rollback, or hardware rollback is required.
